moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Instance name
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: What this instance is called where people see it: the name of the company or of the installation

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Default locale
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The language and formats shown for a person who has chosen none; a person's own locale wins

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Default time zone
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The time zone times are shown in for a person who has chosen none; a person's own zone wins, and business dates keep their owners' meaning

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: New-device sign-in window (days)
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: A sign-in from a client not seen for this many days is reported to the account's owner as a new device

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Group recipient ceiling
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The most recipients one scheduled report or business alert rule may deliver to as a group; an organization's own cap is at most this

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Instance purpose
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Production, test or development: what the instance is run for
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set instance_purpose in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Server default locale
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The locale of a session with no user and no preference above
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set default_locale in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Server time zone
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The zone the server reads a time with no zone in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set default_time_zone in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Database time zone
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The zone times are stored in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set before the first start; changing it later changes the meaning of stored times

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Public host name
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The host name links in mail and redirects are made with
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set webapp_http_host in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: HTTPS links
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether links are made with https
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set webapp_https_enabled in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Largest upload (bytes)
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The largest request body the web server accepts
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set webapp_max_upload in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Telemetry
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether traces, metrics and logs are kept for Monitor
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set telemetry_enabled in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Shortest password
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The fewest characters a new password may have
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set min-length on user-facade password in the runtime conf (System, Conf) and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Digits required
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The fewest digits a new password must hold
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set min-digits on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Other characters required
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The fewest characters that are neither letter nor digit a new password must hold
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set min-others on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Earlier passwords refused
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: How many of an account's last passwords may not be chosen again
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set history-limit on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Weeks until a change is required
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: After this many weeks a sign-in asks for a new password
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set change-weeks on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Change required after a reset
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether a password sent by a reset must be changed at the next sign-in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set email-require-change on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Hours a reset stays usable
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: How long a password sent by a reset may be used
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set email-expire-hours on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Failed sign-ins before a lock
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: After this many wrong passwords in a row the account is locked for a time
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set max-failures on user-facade login in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Minutes a lock lasts
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: How long an account stays locked after too many wrong passwords
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set disable-minutes on user-facade login in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Sign-in history kept
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether each sign-in leaves a history row, which Sessions and the new-device notice read
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set history-store on user-facade login in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Minutes until an idle session ends
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: A web session with no request for this long expires; 0 never
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set timeout on session-config of the webroot webapp in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Hours a browser stays signed in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: How long the sign-in a browser keeps between sessions lasts
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set expire-hours on user-facade login-key in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Hours an app stays signed in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: How long the sign-in of a desktop or mobile app lasts
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set device-expire-hours on user-facade login-key in the runtime conf and reload the conf
